tool_args.rationale: The pilot covers only H = 0.16–0.48, while the target horizon is 23.3. The archived sink-coupled dual-horizon mechanism specifically requires a slow-horizon discriminating probe to identify its slow adaptation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit sink-coupled dual-horizon adaptation from the pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations cannot reliably identify five parameters or establish the slow response at H = 23.3.
A long-horizon probe more directly tests the suspected slow adaptation and forecast reversal.
They do not resolve the observed endogenous-adaptation candidate or the large forecast-horizon extrapolation.
